create.doc:
Creates and shares a new staking object.

 This function must only be called by the initialization function.

register_candidate.doc: Creates a staking pool for the candidate, registers the candidate as a storage node.

set_next_commission.doc:
Sets next_commission in the staking pool, which will then take effect as commission rate
 one epoch after setting the value (to allow stakers to react to setting this).

collect_commission.doc:
Collects the commission for the node. Transaction sender must be the
 `CommissionReceiver` for the `StakingPool`.

set_commission_receiver.doc: Sets the commission receiver for the node.

set_governance_authorized.doc: Sets the governance authorized object for the pool.

check_governance_authorization.doc: Checks if the governance authorized object matches the authenticated object.

get_current_node_weight.doc: Returns the current node weight for the given node id.

compute_next_committee.doc: Computes the committee for the next epoch.

set_storage_price_vote.doc: Sets the storage price vote for the pool.

set_write_price_vote.doc: Sets the write price vote for the pool.

set_node_capacity_vote.doc: Sets the node capacity vote for the pool.

set_next_public_key.doc:
Sets the public key of a node to be used starting from the next epoch for which the node is
 selected.

set_name.doc: Sets the name of a storage node.

set_network_address.doc: Sets the network address or host of a storage node.

set_network_public_key.doc: Sets the public key used for TLS communication for a node.

set_node_metadata.doc: Sets the metadata of a storage node.

voting_end.doc:
Ends the voting period and runs the apportionment if the current time allows.

 This function is permissionless and can be called by anyone.
 Emits the `EpochParametersSelected` event.

initiate_epoch_change.doc:
Initiates the epoch change if the current time allows.

 Emits the `EpochChangeStart` event.

epoch_sync_done.doc: Signals to the contract that the node has received all its shards for the new epoch.

request_withdraw_stake.doc:
Marks the amount as a withdrawal to be processed and removes it from
 the stake weight of the node.

 Allows the user to call `withdraw_stake` after the epoch change to the next epoch
 and shard transfer is done.

withdraw_stake.doc: Withdraws the staked amount from the staking pool.

try_join_active_set.doc:
Allows a node to join the active set if it has sufficient stake.

 This can be useful if another node in the active set had its stake reduced
 below that of the current node. In that case, the current node will be added
 to the active set either the next time stake is added or by calling this function.

add_commission_to_pools.doc: Adds `commissions[i]` to the commission of pool `node_ids[i]`.

epoch.doc: Returns the current epoch of the staking object.

is_quorum.doc: Checks if the weight reaches a quorum.

calculate_rewards.doc:
Calculates the rewards for an amount with value `staked_principal`, staked in the pool
 with the given `node_id` between `activation_epoch` and `withdraw_epoch`.

 This function can be used with `dev_inspect` to calculate the expected rewards for a
 `StakedWal` object or, more generally, the returns provided by a given node over a
 given period.

can_withdraw_staked_wal_early.doc: Call `staked_wal::can_withdraw_early` to allow calling this method in applications.

set_migration_epoch.doc: Sets the epoch in which the staking and system objects can be migrated after an upgrade.

migrate.doc:
Migrate the staking object to the new package id.

 This function sets the new package id and version and can be modified in future versions
 to migrate changes in the `staking_inner` object if needed.

inner_mut.doc: Get a mutable reference to `StakingInner` from the `Staking`.

inner.doc: Get an immutable reference to `StakingInner` from the `Staking`.

inner_without_version_check.doc: Get an immutable reference to `StakingInner` from the `Staking` without checking the version.

Staking.doc: The one and only staking object.
